about: Refactor 17, step A0.2: the layer and the module of each source file. scripts/check-layers.mjs reads this file. The longest rule that starts a path gives its module, and a line in files wins over a rule. covers: the folders whose imports the check reads. packages: the module of each workspace package. contracts: the public parts of the areas (step A1.10). A workspace package in the list is the contract of its area, and a package of another area may depend on it. A source file, or a folder with a final /, is a public file: another area may import it, and it imports no file of its own area that is not public, except with import type. placement: the place in the target layout of each tracked folder that is outside covers and packages; the check does not read its imports. The key `*` is each file of the root, and `scripts/*` is each file directly in scripts/. tables: the owner module of each D1 table.
review: Second version, 2026-11-20. The Platform list started from name rules. Reviewed after that: each explicit line was read by name, each file that `node scripts/check-layers.mjs --misfits` flags was read, and the writers of each D1 table were compared with the module of the table (`--tables`). The Portal list was placed by hand. A file is not proven right by this review: a wrong line shows as a crossing with no reason. The module foundation/connections holds the account, attempt and resource records of a connection (step A1.8); it sits below authority in the order, because the access model and the Vault read those records. A client of an outside provider that imports no module above the kernel belongs to foundation/connections, or to the one module that uses it.

mixed.services/platform/src/agent-tools/regist: The one list of the agent tools. It imports each family, so it is a part of the Worker. The class SessionDO gives it to the Session (step A1.7).
mixed.services/platform/src/agent-tools/sessio: Holds the exit check of the foundation and helpers of four areas. Split in step A1.4.
mixed.services/platform/src/actors/organisatio: The class OrganisationDO with logic of tenancy, authority, commerce and collaboration. The class becomes a shell of the Worker in steps A1.1 and A1.5.

Helpers of the class OrganisationDO: the command runner, the socket sweep, the alarm time and the commerce board presence. The helpers of the policy, the Organisation record and Code Mode left in step A1.9.
mixed.services/platform/src/actors/connector.t: The class ConnectorDO. It joins the Slack, email, WhatsApp and Eval parts of the Connector actor. The class becomes a shell of the Worker in step A1.9.
mixed.apps/portal/src/route.ts: The page list of the Portal: the path, the title and the navigation group of each page. Each area reads it to make a link, and it imports no area. It names the pages of every area in one union; an area registers its own pages when the Portal gets a page registry (step A1.10).
